strike.text: trench (TR93-11) resulted in 3.44 g/t Au over 10.5 m, and additional trenching extended the Eureka Zone over 370 m of strike length. Phase two consisted of seven drill holes at the Eureka Zon

metallurgy.summary: refractory, preg-robbing, sulphide ore, arsenic-bearing; processed by flotation to concentrate, then pressure oxidation, then cyanide leach (CIL/CIP), then dense media separation; stated recovery Au 90%, Cu 80%, Ag 80%
